title: Osterwalder–Schrader Positivity in Free Probability
exact_target: Can Euclidean reflection positivity be formulated meaningfully for free probability and noncommuting random variables?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003670 (OWR-15960-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Reflection Positivity (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/55, pp. 3263--3343. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 47, 48.
Speicher, Bi-Free Probability and Reflection Positivity (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
OWR Report 55/2017 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The reflection, ordering convention and positive-time algebra are to be constructed or characterized. The displayed form only explains the type of positivity sought; it is not a universal axiom already satisfied by every noncommutative state.
